sentences.text:
Vibhoar Agarwal vs The State Of West Bengal And Anr on 16
November, 2023
In The High Court At Calcutta 18-11-2023 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction Subha Item no.
308 Crr 4033 of 2023 Ct no.34 Vibhoar Agarwal
-versus-
The State of West Bengal and Anr.
Mr. Ayan Bhattacharjee Mr. Shounak Mondal Ms. Moumita Bhattacharjee ....for the petitioner.

entities.text: Vibhoar Agarwal vs The State Of West Bengal And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the revisional application upon the opposite party no.1 through the office of the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and upon the opposite party no.2 by speed post with acknowledgement due and file affidavit of service on the next date fixed for hearing.
Mr. Bhattacharjee, learned advocate for the petitioner has drawn the attention of this court to the letter of complaint which has been treated to be the first information report in connection with the Liluah Police Station Case No. 72 of 2023 dated February 22, 2023 under Sections 406/420 of the Indian Penal Code.
Learned advocate has drawn the attention of this court to the relevant part for non-payment pursuant to supply of the materials.
Having considered the statements so advanced, I am of the view that the revisional application is required to be heard out on merits.
Accordingly, list this revisional application under the heading "Contested Application" in the monthly list of January, 2024.
Pending hearing of the revisional application, further proceedings in connection with Liluah P. S.
Case No. 72 of 2023 presently pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Howrah be stayed till 31st January, 2024.
All concerned parties are to act in terms of a copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this court.
[Tirthankar Ghosh, J]
